description: This script benchmarks the performance of PyTorch's MultiheadAttention's fast path (BetterTransformer) versus the slow path, including correctness checks and performance metrics collection.

methods.name: benchmark_torch_function
methods.description: Measures execution time of a function over multiple iterations using CUDA events for timing.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Sets up and runs a performance benchmark for MultiheadAttention with different sequence lengths and batch sizes, including correctness assertions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Coordinates multiple benchmark runs over various parameter combinations, collects results, and outputs performance tables and error logs.
